summary: This file is a configuration file for OpenMMLab MMDetection3D. It contains only a _base_ list that inherits from 4 other config files. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs — it is purely declarative configuration for training a PointPillars 3D object detection model on the Lyft dataset.
note: No callable code or APIs present. This is a config inheritance file composed entirely of variable assignments (a single _base_ list). Per guidelines, no fabricated examples are included.
config_purpose: PointPillars FPN 3D detection model configuration for the Lyft dataset with 200m point cloud range, 9 object classes, 24 training epochs, and AdamW optimizer

example_statements.run_pointpillars_lyft_training: run the mmdetection3d training loop using this PointPillars config for 3D object detection on the Lyft dataset
example_statements.review_pointpillars_config: review the PointPillars FPN configuration inheriting model, dataset, schedule, and runtime settings for Lyft 3D detection
example_statements.summarize_config_inheritance: summarize the config inheritance chain linking model, dataset, schedule, and runtime base configs for Lyft training
example_statements.build_lyft_3d_detector: build a 3D object detector for the Lyft dataset using PointPillars FPN with a 200 meter point cloud range
example_statements.test_pointpillars_inference: test the PointPillars model on Lyft validation data using this config with 9 class 3D bounding box detection
